name: Prolintane
summary: A stimulant drug which is a dopamine reuptake inhibitor related to MDPV and pyrovalerone. The drug was first developed in the 1950's and there are many reported cases of abuse for this drug.

pharmacology.text: Prolintane is a central nervous system (CNS) stimulant and norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (NDRI) of the phenylalkylpyrrolidine family developed in the 1950s. Being an amphetamine derivative, it is closely related in chemical structure to other drugs such as pyrovalerone, MDPV, and propylhexedrine, and has a similar mechanism of action.

uses.text: It was most often used by students and workers as a stimulant to provide energy and increase alertness and concentration.

summaryZh: 普羅林坦是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C15H23N，可以用作興奮劑和去甲腎上腺素-多巴胺再吸收抑制劑，1950年代開發。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include sleeplessness, loss of appetite, anxiety, a fast heartbeat and raised blood pressure. It has been misused, and heavy use can cause paranoia and lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括失眠、食慾減退、焦慮、心跳加快和血壓升高。它曾被濫用，大量使用可能引起偏執並導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括失眠、食欲减退、焦虑、心跳加快和血压升高。它曾被滥用，大量使用可能引起偏执并导致依赖。

fact.en: Prolintane was developed by Boehringer Ingelheim in the 1950s and was sold in some countries as Katovit, a tonic that combined it with vitamins.
fact.zh: 普羅林坦由百靈佳殷格翰在 1950 年代開發，在部分國家曾以 Katovit 之名販售，這是一種把它和維生素混合的補給藥。
fact.zhHans: 普罗林坦由百灵佳殷格翰在 1950 年代开发，在部分国家曾以 Katovit 之名贩售，这是一种把它和维生素混合的补给药。
